Celebrating the legalization of same-sex marriage in the U.S., #LoveWins became a global symbol of LGBTQ+ rights and equality. 🌈

Launched by the UN, this movement encouraged men to support gender equality and join the fight against discrimination. 👥

This hashtag became a symbol of solidarity for Ukraine in the wake of Russia's invasion, spreading awareness and rallying global support. 🇺🇦

A call to end police brutality in Nigeria, #EndSARS mobilized protests and drew attention to the country’s broader human rights issues. 🇳🇬

9. #StopAsianHate
This hashtag emerged in response to rising anti-Asian violence, calling for unity and an end to hate crimes. 🧡

10. #OccupyWallStreet
A protest against economic inequality, it sparked discussions on wealth disparity and corporate influence in politics. 💼
